items.source: Overridden to turn it into a no-op: With AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext, getBeanFactory() serves a strong assertion for an active context anyway.
items.translation: 重写以将其变为空操作：对于 `AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext`，getBeanFactory() 无论如何都提供了一个有效的断言来确认上下文处于活动状态。

items.source: Concrete standalone subclasses of this base class, reading in a specific bean definition format, are ClassPathXmlApplicationContext and FileSystemXmlApplicationContext, which both derive from the common AbstractXmlApplicationContext base class; AnnotationConfigApplicationContext supports @Configuration-annotated classes as a source of bean definitions.
items.translation: 读取特定 Bean 定义格式的该基类的具体独立子类是 `ClassPathXmlApplicationContext` 和 `FileSystemXmlApplicationContext`，它们都源自共同的 `AbstractXmlApplicationContext` 基类；`AnnotationConfigApplicationContext` 支持使用 `@Configuration` 注解的类作为 Bean 定义源。

items.source: The only method to be implemented by subclasses is loadBeanDefinitions(DefaultListableBeanFactory), which gets invoked on each refresh. A concrete implementation is supposed to load bean definitions into the given DefaultListableBeanFactory, typically delegating to one or more specific bean definition readers.
items.translation: 子类需要实现的唯一方法是 loadBeanDefinitions(DefaultListableBeanFactory)，该方法在每次刷新时都会被调用。具体实现应该将 bean 定义加载到给定的 DefaultListableBeanFactory 中，通常通过委托给一个或多个特定的 bean 定义读取器来实现。

items.source: The default implementation applies this context's "allowBeanDefinitionOverriding" and "allowCircularReferences" settings, if specified. Can be overridden in subclasses to customize any of DefaultListableBeanFactory's settings.
items.translation: 默认实现会应用此上下文中指定的 "allowBeanDefinitionOverriding" 和 "allowCircularReferences" 设置。可以在子类中重写它以自定义任何 DefaultListableBeanFactory 的设置。

items.source: Note that there is a similar base class for WebApplicationContexts. AbstractRefreshableWebApplicationContext provides the same subclassing strategy, but additionally pre-implements all context functionality for web environments. There is also a pre-defined way to receive config locations for a web context.
items.translation: 请注意，WebApplicationContext 也有一个类似的基类。 AbstractRefreshableWebApplicationContext 提供了相同的子类化策略，但此外还预先实现了所有针对 Web 环境的功能。此外，还有一种预定义的方式来接收 Web 环境的配置位置。

items.source: The default implementation creates a DefaultListableBeanFactory with the internal bean factory of this context's parent as parent bean factory. Can be overridden in subclasses, for example to customize DefaultListableBeanFactory's settings.
items.translation: 默认实现会创建一个`DefaultListableBeanFactory`，其父 bean 工厂为上下文的父对象的内部 bean 工厂。可在子类中重写此方法，例如用于自定义`DefaultListableBeanFactory`的设置。

items.source:
This implementation performs an actual refresh of this context's underlying
bean factory, shutting down the previous bean factory (if any) and
initializing a fresh bean factory for the next phase of the context's lifecycle.
items.translation: 此实现会实际刷新该上下文的基础 Bean 工厂，关闭之前的 Bean 工厂（如果有），并为上下文的下一个生命周期阶段初始化一个新的 Bean 工厂。

items.source:
Set whether it should be allowed to override bean definitions by registering
a different definition with the same name, automatically replacing the former.
If not, an exception will be thrown. Default is "true".
items.translation: 设置是否允许通过注册具有相同名称的不同定义来覆盖 Bean 定义，从而自动替换前者。如果不允许，将抛出异常。默认值为"true"。

items.translation: 确定当前上下文是否持有 BeanFactory，即是否至少刷新过一次且尚未关闭。
